quizzes.title: India-France Partnership: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: India and France have upgraded their ties to a special global strategic partnership during a visit by the French President. Cooperation between the two countries now spans defence manufacturing, technology, critical minerals, nuclear energy and trade. The economic side includes cooperation on the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor, and the partnership also includes joint military exercises by the army, navy and air force. A final assembly line for a light utility helicopter has been inaugurated in India as part of a private aviation facility. A joint venture with a French firm will also produce a missile in India. Earth observation is another area of joint work, and the two countries have agreed to amend their double tax avoidance agreement. A large nuclear project is being built in India with a French utility. The roadmap sets the course for the bilateral relationship in all areas. France has been the Chief Guest at India's Republic Day celebrations more than once. Namaste France 2028 is planned as a celebration of the partnership, marking a milestone in its long history. The two sides have also agreed on a joint declaration about critical minerals. Each of these areas is covered in the joint outcomes announced during the visit.

questions.q: Which joint Earth observation mission is India collaborating on with France?
questions.explanation: The booklet says India is collaborating with France on the joint Earth Observation Mission TRISHNA.

questions.q: Namaste France 2028 is planned to celebrate how many years of the Strategic Partnership?
questions.explanation: The booklet says Namaste France 2028 will celebrate 30 years of the Strategic Partnership.

questions.q: Which summit is India set to attend in July 2026 in France?
questions.explanation: The booklet says India is to attend the International Space Summit in July 2026 in France.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): A joint venture with Dassault Aviation produces the HAMMER missile in India.
Reason (R): HAMMER is a smart precision guided air-to-ground weapon for Rafale and LCA Tejas.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The HAMMER joint venture is between Bharat Electronics and Safran, not Dassault, so A is false while R is true.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. H125 helicopter final assembly line   ->   C. AIIMS, Delhi
II. Jaitapur nuclear park   ->   D. Joint venture of Bharat Electronics and Safran
III. Indo-French Centre for AI in Health   ->   A. Maharashtra
IV. HAMMER missile production   ->   B. Karnataka (Vemagal)
questions.explanation: H125 is at Vemagal in Karnataka, Jaitapur is in Maharashtra, the AI in Health centre is at AIIMS Delhi, and HAMMER is made by the BEL-Safran joint venture.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Indo-French Centre for Digital Sciences and Technology has been inaugurated.
II. France has invited India's Prime Minister to attend the 2026 G7 summit in France.
III. The joint declaration on critical minerals concerns supply chains of nuclear fuel.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are true, while III is false because the declaration concerns critical minerals.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. Cooperation was deepened in small and advanced modular reactors.
II. The India-France Year of Innovation is in 2027.
III. An India-France Innovation Network has been established.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while the India-France Year of Innovation is 2026, not 2027.

quizzes.title: Chabahar Port and Arab League: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: Chabahar Port is located on the Makran Coast of Iran, close to the Gulf of Oman and the Strait of Hormuz. It is the Iranian port closest to India, and it offers a direct route to Afghanistan and Central Asia that avoids Pakistan. India has been involved with the port for a long time, and the port has been developed through agreements between the two countries. The Chabahar-Zahedan railway is planned to connect the port to Afghanistan's highway network. The Arab League is a regional organisation of Arab countries that coordinates policies on political, security, economic and legal issues. Its region is the Middle East and parts of Africa. The organisation stresses respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all states and calls for cooperation against terrorism. The Arab League has also supported reforms of the United Nations Security Council to reflect contemporary global realities. India and the Arab League have adopted a joint declaration on peace, security and global governance. The Arab States supply a large share of India's crude oil imports, and many Indians live and work in Arab League countries. Stability in the region is considered vital for India's energy security and supply chains. Chabahar also offers India a counterbalance in the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: In which Iranian province is Chabahar Port located?
questions.explanation: The booklet places Chabahar Port on the Makran Coast of Sistan-Baluchistan Province.

questions.q: In which year did discussions on Indian participation in Chabahar Port begin?
questions.explanation: The booklet says discussions on Indian participation in Chabahar began in 2002.

questions.q: Chabahar is an integral part of which corridor?
questions.explanation: The booklet says Chabahar is an integral part of the International North-South Transport Corridor.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Iran reaffirmed its commitment to Chabahar Port despite US sanctions uncertainty.
Reason (R): India Ports Global assumed operational control of Chabahar Port in 2018.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, but the 2018 takeover by India Ports Global does not explain Iran's reaffirmation.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Arab League   ->   D. Suez Canal-Red Sea Economic and Maritime Development Initiative
II. Chabahar Port   ->   A. Part of China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
III. STREAM   ->   B. Established in 1945 in Cairo
IV. Gwadar port   ->   C. Iran's only ocean-facing deep-water port
questions.explanation: The Arab League was established in 1945 in Cairo, Chabahar is Iran's only ocean-facing deep-water port, STREAM is the Suez Canal-Red Sea initiative, and Gwadar is part of CPEC.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. Chabahar Port lies about 550 nautical miles from Gujarat's Kandla Port.
II. Formal recognition of Indian participation in Chabahar came in the 2002 New Delhi Declaration.
III. The Arab League's headquarters is located in Cairo, Egypt.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement I and III are true, while II is false because formal recognition came in 2003.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Arab League has highlighted STREAM as a key regional framework.
II. Palestine is not counted among the members of the Arab League.
III. India Ports Global assumed operational control of Chabahar Port in 2015.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Only statement I is true, since Palestine is a member and India Ports Global took control in 2018.

quizzes.title: Malaysia and Seychelles Visits: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: India's Prime Minister made an official visit to Malaysia, and the two countries issued a joint statement covering strategic, defence, digital and trade cooperation. The defence part of the statement focuses on maintenance, technical expertise and supply chain resilience. Both sides emphasised balanced and diversified bilateral trade, with priority given to semiconductors, the digital economy and advanced manufacturing. Malaysia has also reiterated its commitment to the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea and to freedom of navigation and overflight. Malaysia is an important partner for India within the ASEAN grouping, and the two countries are to co-chair an expert working group of ASEAN defence ministers for 2024 to 2027. Malaysia has reiterated its role as a reliable supplier of palm oil to India. Malaysia and India also hold joint military exercises involving the army, navy and air force. Separately, the President of Seychelles visited India and announced a package of assistance. The focus areas of this support are development projects, capacity building and maritime security cooperation. Seychelles is an island country in the Indian Ocean. Both the Malaysia and Seychelles visits stress disaster-resilient infrastructure, and the Seychelles visit also stresses maritime security. Both countries are to work together through the working groups set up during the visit.

questions.q: The Harimau Shakti joint military exercise with Malaysia is held in which edition?
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the Harimau Shakti joint military exercise with Malaysia as its 5th Edition.

questions.q: The SESEL joint vision marks how many years of diplomatic relations between India and Seychelles?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the SESEL joint vision marks 50 years of diplomatic relations.

questions.q: How much assistance package did India announce for Seychelles (in USD)?
questions.explanation: The booklet says India announced a USD 175 million assistance package for Seychelles.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Seychelles agreed to join the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure.
Reason (R): Malaysia formally acceded to the International Big Cat Alliance.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, and Malaysia's accession to the Big Cat Alliance does not explain Seychelles' agreement to join the coalition.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Harimau Shakti joint exercise   ->   C. Regional security grouping of India, Maldives, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Mauritius
II. Malaysia-India Digital Council   ->   B. Joint military exercise with Malaysia
III. Colombo Security Conclave   ->   D. Alliance for the conservation of big cats
IV. International Big Cat Alliance   ->   A. Cooperation on fintech, AI, cybersecurity and e-governance
questions.explanation: Harimau Shakti is a joint military exercise, the Digital Council covers fintech and AI, the Colombo Security Conclave is a regional security grouping, and the Big Cat Alliance is a conservation alliance.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. RBI and Bank Negara Malaysia are to promote local currency settlement.
II. Victoria is the capital of Seychelles.
III. India announced a USD 175 million assistance package for Malaysia.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are true, while the USD 175 million package was announced for Seychelles, not Malaysia.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Malaysia-India Digital Council covers fintech, AI, cybersecurity and e-governance.
II. The Su-30 Forum was created to enhance cooperation between the navies of India and Malaysia.
III. Anwar Ibrahim is the Prime Minister of Malaysia.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while the Su-30 Forum was created for air forces, not navies.
